page.overview:
Who is Ancient Minister?

The Ancient Minister is one of the antagonists who appears in Adventure Mode: The Subspace Emissary in Super Smash Bros. Brawl. The Ancient Minister is only shown during cutscenes, not gameplay, and most of his cutscene appearances also feature at least one Mario character.

In the backstory for Adventure Mode: The Subspace Emissary, the Ancient Minister was once the leader of the Isle of Ancients, named the Master Robot, and he watched over the World of Trophies along with other R.O.B.s. When Tabuu invaded the Isle of Ancients, the Ancient Minister reluctantly joined his side because he did not want to lose all of his R.O.B.s to him.
